skills.name: csv-dedup
skills.description: Use when a delimited export contains repeated records and you need a stable merge key.
skills.content: csv-dedup compares normalized column values, keeps the newest source row, and records discarded identifiers for audit.

skills.name: api-contract-audit
skills.description: Use when reviewing request and response compatibility for a public HTTP endpoint.
skills.content: api-contract-audit checks required fields, status codes, examples, and backward-compatible error shapes before release.

skills.name: invoice-reconcile
skills.description: Use when matching invoices, purchase orders, and payments with tolerances.
skills.content: invoice-reconcile matches reference numbers first, then compares currency, tax, and approved amount tolerances.

skills.name: incident-triage
skills.description: Use when an operational alert needs severity, impact, and first-response classification.
skills.content: incident-triage separates customer impact from noisy symptoms and records a reversible mitigation before root-cause work.

skills.name: map-tile-cache
skills.description: Use when map images are stale, missing, or costly to render repeatedly.
skills.content: map-tile-cache defines cache keys from layer version, tile coordinates, style revision, and expiry behavior.

skills.name: accessibility-audit
skills.description: Use when checking keyboard operation, semantic controls, contrast, and assistive-technology labels.
skills.content: accessibility-audit tests focus order, visible focus, labels, contrast, and error announcements against the user flow.

skills.name: sql-window-analysis
skills.description: Use when calculating rankings, moving values, or groups without collapsing rows.
skills.content: sql-window-analysis selects explicit partitions and ordering, then validates ties and boundary rows with a small fixture.

skills.name: release-note-draft
skills.description: Use when turning completed changes into concise customer-facing release notes.
skills.content: release-note-draft states the user-visible change, eligibility, and any action needed while omitting internal implementation detail.

skills.name: db-schema-migrate
skills.description: Use when planning a compatible database schema change with rollout and rollback steps.
skills.content: db-schema-migrate uses expand, backfill, switch, and contract phases so older application versions remain safe during deployment.

skills.name: translation-localize
skills.description: Use when adapting product copy for another language while preserving UI constraints.
skills.content: translation-localize preserves variables, plural rules, register, and maximum interface length rather than translating word for word.

skills.name: forecast-backtest
skills.description: Use when evaluating predictions against historical observations without leakage.
skills.content: forecast-backtest fixes the prediction cutoff, uses rolling evaluation windows, and reports error by relevant segment.

skills.name: privacy-redaction
skills.description: Use when preparing records for sharing and identifying sensitive fields to remove or mask.
skills.content: privacy-redaction minimizes retained fields, masks direct identifiers, and checks free text for accidental disclosure.

skills.name: kubernetes-rollout
skills.description: Use when safely deploying a service revision with health checks and rollback conditions.
skills.content: kubernetes-rollout configures readiness checks, bounded surge, observation windows, and a concrete rollback trigger.

skills.name: experiment-design
skills.description: Use when defining a controlled product experiment and a decision rule before launch.
skills.content: experiment-design names the hypothesis, primary measure, assignment unit, guardrails, and stop decision before data collection.

skills.name: email-deliverability
skills.description: Use when transactional email is delayed, rejected, or landing outside the inbox.
skills.content: email-deliverability checks authentication alignment, bounce classes, sending reputation, and unsubscribe headers.

skills.name: geocoding-validate
skills.description: Use when validating place lookup results, coordinate precision, and ambiguous addresses.
skills.content: geocoding-validate retains the original query, records confidence, and requires an explicit ambiguity policy for similar places.

memories.text: EVIDENCE_ALPHA_RETRY_POLICY Alpha retries HTTP 502 and 503 twice with jitter; it never retries a rejected measurement payload.
EVIDENCE_ALPHA_TILE_STYLE Alpha map style changes increment the style revision, which must be part of the rendered-tile key.
EVIDENCE_BETA_TAX_TOLERANCE Beta accepts a tax delta of at most 0.02 only after the purchase-order reference matches.
EVIDENCE_BETA_FORM_FOCUS Beta's address-search dialog must return keyboard focus to the triggering field after selection or cancel.

wiki.text: EVIDENCE_ALPHA_STATION_PROTOCOL Station packets use source sequence numbers to detect replays; late packets remain valid when their sequence is new.
EVIDENCE_ALPHA_TILE_LIFETIME Rain-map tiles expire after one hour unless a layer or style revision changes first.
EVIDENCE_BETA_INVOICE_RULES Invoice matching compares reference, currency, tax, and amount; a human reviews unmatched exceptions.
EVIDENCE_BETA_PERMIT_METRICS Permit forecasting reports mean absolute error separately for renovation and new-build submissions.
